admission.utc_days: closed, chronological and contiguous from the holdout start
admission.immutable_inputs: each admitted day, aggregate ledger, status and terminal verdict are SHA-256 pinned
admission.crash_recovery: a hashed write-ahead journal deterministically rebuilds ledger, status and verdict after every commit boundary
admission.runtime_binding: the evaluator loads this file and the protocol by checksum; caller-supplied rules or hashes must be identical
admission.causal_execution: evaluation books cannot be newer than their evaluation clocks; decision books cannot be newer than decisions
admission.economics: five-share targets, fixed limits, direct fill levels, VWAP, exact fee rounding, total cost and PnL are independently recomputed
admission.paired_latencies: 400 and 500 ms rows share one immutable decision
admission.matched_controls: every base signal has exactly one same-decision direction reversal and one resolved five-second time shift

stopping.primary: resolved full five-share base fills only
stopping.common_cutoff: earliest decision receipt timestamp satisfying the frozen fill and UTC-day minima at both 400 and 500 ms
stopping.partials: reported in risk, PnL and EV but never advance stopping
stopping.controls: all four controls must be observed and every matched control must be resolved before promotion
stopping.statistics: positive net EV, positive one-sided day-cluster lower bound and Bonferroni-adjusted exact p-value at both latencies
